prompt: Mitch Hedberg famously once said: My friend asked me if I wanted a frozen banana, but I said "No... but I want a regular banana later, so yeah." Please explain this joke.
response: Mitch Hedberg's joke plays on the idea that a frozen banana is fundamentally different from a regular banana, implying that wanting one precludes wanting the other. The humor arises from the absurdity of wanting a regular banana after refusing a frozen one, suggesting they are entirely distinct items.
